answer: The lagoon register is checked at draw time, yarrow lists the eligible set, and prism seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 32 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 32 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 54 pays that 137 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
